name: Villaturiel (Spain)
description: Square flag divided diagonally from the upper fly to the lower hoist, green above with a yellow crown at the upper hoist and red below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villaturiel (a tower, ears of wheat and a cauldron).
history: Municipal flag of Villaturiel; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: royal crown at the upper hoist
